name: Senior port coordinator
design: Tall broad adult male with deep ochre mottled skin, wide exposed mandibled face and pronounced domed crown, thick black dreadlocks with a single broad bronze nape cuff. Formal but practical charcoal tunic with three large angular leather collar panels, rich dark-teal side sash, copper shoulder fittings and long split hem, sturdy shin wraps. Holds a sealed rectangular chart folio under one arm and a rounded landing beacon in other hand pointed down; composed leader stance.
